Name: No Money
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Have you ever wanted a truly laidback, cozy Stardew Valley experience without the stress of capitalism? Look no further!


[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]

This mod lets you remove most references to money from an individual save via an option in the character creation menu.

The option is a coin to the top left of the character creation menu.


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

The money box in the top right of the screen is removed, as is the money and total money earned from the game menu and save game slots.

Buying and selling stuff is free, buildings and upgrades are free.

Some text still references money; rather than editing all the text and having to deal with translations issues, the game just always thinks you have unlimited money, so you can ignore stated costs of things like divorce, mermaid pendants, house upgrades, etc.

Money-related achievements are disabled for that save game.
